name: tem-agua
description: Mapa colaborativo de falta d'água em Salto/SP — microfrontends Angular + React + Vue com Module Federation

scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/mapa && npm run build -w apps/painel && npm run build -w apps/metricas && npm run build -w apps/shell
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/mapa && npm run typecheck -w apps/painel && npm run typecheck -w apps/metricas
scripts.lint:frontend: eslint apps/shell apps/mapa apps/painel apps/metricas packages/contracts
scripts.db:psql: docker compose -f ../compose.yaml exec db psql -U temagua -d temagua
